claim: A game frame running with interrupts off that overruns one video frame misses the interrupt it spans, so that limiter cycle takes one extra interrupt; track the raster and credit missed interrupts.
limit: Times are simulated and optimistic: wait states are modelled by an 8/6.5 factor.

evidence.text: A game frame longer than one video frame (20 ms) loses the interrupt it spans; the limiter then counts from the next, so that cycle takes 4 interrupts: 8 % and 17 % of game frames over 20 ms in two recordings (x 8/6.5 for 28 MHz wait states).

evidence.text: The raster line is sampled at the interrupt, render start, band ends and frame end; a sample below the previous one is a wrap, and missed interrupts are credited.
evidence.quote: a sample below the previous one = a wrap (V_WR)

evidence.text: The redraw after a lost life went from 124 frames to 57-58 on JNext; the update then starts at the next interrupt, so it moves in 20 ms steps.
evidence.quote: Result 57 to 58 frames, on JNext; the update then starts at the next interrupt, so it moves in 20 ms steps.
